MERCHANT RANGE: GRADUATION AND DIRECT ENTRY | G3-G6
+-- Plus paths
|   +-- [S] Q4 2018: over half of Plus adds were new to Shopify.
|   +-- [S] Q1 2019: management expected that mix to continue.
|   +-- [S] 2021: 14,000+ Plus merchants; about 4,000 added that year.
|   +-- [S] 2022: self-serve upgrades supply about 25% of Plus adds.
|   `-- [I] Self-serve share is not the share of all upgrades.
+-- Enterprise initiative: launch and expansion
|   +-- [S] Q1 2023: CCS offers components alongside existing systems.
|   +-- [S] Partners: Accenture, Deloitte, EY, KPMG, IBM Consulting.
|   +-- [S] Q4 2024: some CCS merchants move to the full suite.
|   +-- [S] Q1 2026: $100M+ GMV merchant count nearly doubles in 2 years.
|   `-- CCS + integrators -[claim]-> enterprise adoption
+-- Commercial breadth
|   +-- [R] FY2024: Plus/enterprise account for most GMV.
|   +-- [S] Q3 2025: under-$25M annual GMV merchants account for most GMV.
|   +-- [S] Q3 2026: $2M-$25M band is largest; leads incremental GMV.
|   +-- [S] Growth in that band mostly comes from shops graduating up.
|   `-- [I] Plan tier and GMV band overlap; no contradiction implied.
+-- MRR share is an incomplete upmarket gauge
    [S] Plus share: 25% 2018; 29% 2021; 34% Q3 2026.
    [S] Q3 2026: MRR underrepresents larger-GMV merchants.
    [I] Price, trial timing and non-Plus growth also move the share.
    [I] No enterprise base count or quantified integrator attribution.
